question.en: Discuss the role of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in bridging the global digital divide.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in bridging the global digital divide.

modelAnswer.en: The ITU plays a critical role by setting technical standards, providing policy advice to developing nations, and coordinating infrastructure projects to ensure universal access to ICTs, thereby reducing the digital divide.
modelAnswer.hi: The ITU plays a critical role by setting technical standards, providing policy advice to developing nations, and coordinating infrastructure projects to ensure universal access to ICTs, thereby reducing the digital divide.
